items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: The interviewee discusses George Lewis in the context of other musicians (Bung, Buddy Petit) and their playing styles, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with George Lewis himself.

ctx.x: Bung was sort of a sweet.
Sweet. Oh yeah. Bung was a sweet something like Buddy and Lewis and those. All them had the tree and style because Buddy, I mean Bung, partly learned Lewis, Buddy Petit, everything he knew.
That's what Bung told me too, yes. Yeah.
